_meta: G7 fragment (owner: CREEP7). rules.g7_machine: creep layer, dormant seeds, purges, Machine EW (hack/EMP), living cores, escalation phases, learned reactions (G7 master scope sections 8, 6.3, 10). Every number is PROVISIONAL (untuned balance fixture). Creep runs only when enabled: cfg.creep == true, cfg.mode == 'last_protocol', Creep.enable(w), or a seed/core is placed; a match without creep keeps its pre-G7 state hash.

creep._note: coarse grid: one creep cell = cell x cell tiles; value 0..255; a cell counts as creep at >= on; update stripes: every cell is visited once per stripe_ticks ticks (rows with row % stripe_ticks == tick % stripe_ticks)

regrow._note: a dormant seed with no living Machine building within clear_radius tiles regrows a structure after regrow_s (nests: nest_regrow_s); revealed seeds regrow too, they just stop being hidden

ew._note: Machine EW: hackers jam the nearest hackable human vehicle/drone in range (weapons and movement held for jam_s); drones are taken over (pulled toward the hacker) for takeover_s. Units flagged unhackable (e.unhackable or def.unhackable) are immune. EMP stuns Machine units (held in place, weapons held).

react._note: learned strictly in order 1..4; 1 = first successful counter-nanite deployment (a standard/seed_hunter/barrier purge by a non-Machine side); 2 = creep cells lost >= lost_cells; 3 = a core or major structure (hq role, core, or max_hp >= major_hp) falls; 4 = tick >= late_tick (or phase >= late_phase)
